export type SessionMode = 'interactive' | 'batch' | 'replay';

export function transitionMode(current: SessionMode, next: SessionMode): SessionMode {
  const record = { mode: current };
  if (record.mode === 'interactive') {
    record.mode = next;
  } else if (record.mode === 'batch') {
    record.mode = next;
  }
  return record.mode;
}

export function resetMode(record: { mode: SessionMode }): void {
  record.mode = 'interactive';
}

export function replayMode(record: { mode: SessionMode }): void {
  record.mode = 'replay';
}
